chains.species: Any pet that "fits through the door" (furry, feathery or scaly)
chains.notes: Brand-wide promise on Kimpton's pet page; individual hotels may still post their own rules, so check the hotel page.

chains.pets: 2 per room (more at manager's discretion, $15/night each)
chains.notes: HomeTowne Studios and The Red Collection set their own rules. Two listed locations (Oxon Hill, MD and Bellmawr, NJ) cannot accept pets.

chains.fee: Optional fee up to $25 per night, max $75 per room per stay

chains.species: Domestic pets such as dogs and cats
chains.notes: Pets are not allowed in the breakfast area, gym or pool. La Quinta lists hotels that take no pets, including La Quinta New York City Central Park, Queens, Brooklyn Downtown and Brooklyn East.

chains.fee: Daily fee, minimum $50 per night (varies by hotel)
chains.notes: Pets are not allowed in the lobby, dining area, pool or fitness center and should not be left alone in the room.
Up-to-date vaccinations required. Loews says additional cleaning fees and property-specific policies may apply: check the hotel's page.
